content.title: White-Plain Whale Reveal | Human Scale, Terrain Misread and Giant Passage
content.summary: An adult surveyor discovers that a white ridge is a sky-whale and survives its dust wake. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject remains the human scale anchor. + The giant form begins as a plausible terrain feature. + Identity clues are revealed progressively before full scale. + Environmental displacement follows one giant-body action. + The final frame preserves both adult and giant geography without implying injury.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one clearly adult salt surveyor alone on an endless white mineral plain holding one red cup. Pull high and wide until one eye, fin edge and complete original sky-whale silhouette become readable. Track the underside passing above the surveyor as she shields her face and remains fully visible in the final dust hold.
required_anchors: One clearly adult subject remains the human scale anchor.
The giant form begins as a plausible terrain feature.
Environmental displacement follows one giant-body action.
The final frame preserves both adult and giant geography without implying injury.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult surveyor discovers that a white ridge is a sky-whale and survives its dust wake. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 官方原视频实测为 25.067 秒而非候选阶段记录的 17 秒；同一成年人物在白色裂地建立微小尺度，远处地貌逐步显出巨鲸身份，巨体起身掀起尘浪并从人物上方经过。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject remains the human scale anchor.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject remains the human scale anchor."

invariants.rule: The giant form begins as a plausible terrain feature.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The giant form begins as a plausible terrain feature."

invariants.rule: Identity clues are revealed progressively before full scale.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Identity clues are revealed progressively before full scale."

invariants.rule: Environmental displacement follows one giant-body action.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Environmental displacement follows one giant-body action."

invariants.rule: The final frame preserves both adult and giant geography without implying injury.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final frame preserves both adult and giant geography without implying injury."

the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
